summary.text: Sandy Ibanez is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
A teacher, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include fair school funding, property tax transparency and access to healthcare.

paragraphs.text: In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, Sandy Ibanez described herself as a teacher and a product of public schools who is running to put people before politics for families in House District 28.
She said she would fight for fair school funding, better support for educators, expanded career and technical education pathways and safe campuses.

She also said she would work to bring transparency to the property tax system and support policies that improve access to healthcare and mental health services and address rising insurance costs for families in Fort Bend County.
